rules.description: Web scanner probing known application paths.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100001" level="5">
  <decoded_as>apache</decoded_as>
  <regex>GET /(view|include|modules|admin|\.\./)</regex>
  <description>Web scanner probing known application paths.</description>
  <group>web_access,recon,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Known vulnerability scanner user agent observed.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100002" level="5">
  <decoded_as>apache</decoded_as>
  <regex>sqlmap|nikto|masscan|acunetix|burp|nmap_</regex>
  <description>Known vulnerability scanner user agent observed.</description>
  <group>web_access,recon,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Likely command injection pattern in web request.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100003" level="10">
  <decoded_as>apache</decoded_as>
  <regex>(cmd|exec|system|eval|wget|curl|/bin/(sh|bash)|powershell|cmd\.exe)</regex>
  <description>Likely command injection pattern in web request.</description>
  <group>web_access,rce,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Script file created inside a monitored webroot.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100004" level="8">
  <if_sid>554</if_sid>
  <regex>\.(php|jsp|jspx|aspx|asp|pl|cgi)$</regex>
  <description>Script file created inside a monitored webroot.</description>
  <group>syscheck,web_upload,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Log4Shell JNDI lookup pattern detected in request.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100005" level="10">
  <decoded_as>apache</decoded_as>
  <regex>\$\{jndi:(ldap|rmi|dns)://</regex>
  <description>Log4Shell JNDI lookup pattern detected in request.</description>
  <group>web_access,rce,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: cmd.exe spawning a powershell child process.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100006" level="7">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">4688</field>
  <regex>cmd\.exe</regex>
  <match>powershell</match>
  <description>cmd.exe spawning a powershell child process.</description>
  <group>windows,execution,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Obfuscated powershell or in-memory download cradle.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100007" level="12">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">4688</field>
  <regex>(hide-window|bypass|-enc|frombase64|iex|downloadstring)</regex>
  <description>Obfuscated powershell or in-memory download cradle.</description>
  <group>windows,execution,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Web server process spawned a shell or utility child.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100008" level="12">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">4688</field>
  <field name="win.eventdata.parentImage">w3wp.exe</field>
  <regex>(cmd|powershell|rundll32|bitsadmin|mshta)\.exe</regex>
  <description>Web server process spawned a shell or utility child.</description>
  <group>windows,execution,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Suspicious windows service installed from writable path.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100009" level="9">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">7045</field>
  <regex>(powershell|\\temp|\\tmp|\\appdata|\\users)</regex>
  <description>Suspicious windows service installed from writable path.</description>
  <group>windows,persistence,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Persistence attempt via a registry Run key modification.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100010" level="10">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">13</field>
  <match>CurrentVersion\Run</match>
  <description>Persistence attempt via a registry Run key modification.</description>
  <group>windows,persistence,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Scheduled job installed or edited (cron).
rules.xml:
<rule id="100011" level="8">
  <decoded_as>syslog</decoded_as>
  <regex>(crontab|at(\.| |\d))</regex>
  <match>crontab</match>
  <description>Scheduled job installed or edited (cron).</description>
  <group>local,persistence,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Sudo privilege elevation event observed.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100012" level="4">
  <decoded_as>syslog</decoded_as>
  <match>sudo</match>
  <description>Sudo privilege elevation event observed.</description>
  <group>local,privilege_escalation,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: UAC bypass stub or elevated binary invocation.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100013" level="10">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">4688</field>
  <regex>(\\sysnative\\cmd|fodhelper|eventvwr\.exe|sdclt\.exe)</regex>
  <description>UAC bypass stub or elevated binary invocation.</description>
  <group>windows,privilege_escalation,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Windows security event log was cleared.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100014" level="12">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">1102</field>
  <description>Windows security event log was cleared.</description>
  <group>windows,defense_evasion,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Attempted removal or truncation of system logs.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100015" level="7">
  <decoded_as>syslog</decoded_as>
  <regex>(rm .*(auth\.log|syslog|messages|wazuh)|truncate -s 0 /var/log)</regex>
  <description>Attempted removal or truncation of system logs.</description>
  <group>local,defense_evasion,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Security agent or detection service targeted for termination.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100016" level="10">
  <decoded_as>syslog</decoded_as>
  <regex>(kill|pkill|killall).*(ossec|wazuh|auditd|falcon|defender)</regex>
  <description>Security agent or detection service targeted for termination.</description>
  <group>local,defense_evasion,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Potential credential dumping of the lsass process.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100017" level="12">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">10</field>
  <field name="win.eventdata.targetImage">lsass.exe</field>
  <regex>(mimikatz|procdump|comsvcs|rundll32)</regex>
  <description>Potential credential dumping of the lsass process.</description>
  <group>windows,credential_access,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Credential store file accessed on a local host.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100018" level="10">
  <decoded_as>syslog</decoded_as>
  <regex>(cat|less|tail|dd|strings).*(/etc/shadow|/etc/passwd)</regex>
  <description>Credential store file accessed on a local host.</description>
  <group>local,credential_access,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Batch of local host or network enumeration commands.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100019" level="5">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">4688</field>
  <regex>(whoami|systeminfo|ipconfig /all|tasklist|\?netstat)</regex>
  <description>Batch of local host or network enumeration commands.</description>
  <group>windows,discovery,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Active directory or local account enumeration.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100020" level="5">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">4688</field>
  <regex>net (user|group|localgroup).* /</regex>
  <description>Active directory or local account enumeration.</description>
  <group>windows,discovery,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Access to an administrative share over the network.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100021" level="12">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">5140</field>
  <regex>(admin\$|c\$)</regex>
  <description>Access to an administrative share over the network.</description>
  <group>windows,lateral_movement,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Failed RDP logon attempt from a network source.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100022" level="8">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">4625</field>
  <field name="win.eventdata.logonType">10</field>
  <description>Failed RDP logon attempt from a network source.</description>
  <group>windows,lateral_movement,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Outbound connection to an atypical service port.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100023" level="8">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">3</field>
  <field name="win.eventdata.state">Connect</field>
  <regex>(:4444|:8080|:8443|:53)</regex>
  <description>Outbound connection to an atypical service port.</description>
  <group>windows,c2,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Potential dns tunneling or encrypted dns resolver use.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100024" level="7">
  <decoded_as>syslog</decoded_as>
  <regex>(dns\.(google|cloudflare|nextdns)|kryptos|\.top|\.xyz|\.link)</regex>
  <description>Potential dns tunneling or encrypted dns resolver use.</description>
  <group>local,c2,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: Exfiltration or transfer utility executed on host.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100025" level="10">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">4688</field>
  <regex>(certutil -urlcache|b64decode|scp|ftp\.exe|nc\.exe)</regex>
  <description>Exfiltration or transfer utility executed on host.</description>
  <group>windows,exfiltration,</group>
</rule>

rules.description: User document directory staged into an archive.
rules.xml:
<rule id="100026" level="9">
  <decoded_as>windows_eventchannel</decoded_as>
  <field name="win.system.eventID">4688</field>
  <regex>(7z|rar|zip|tar).*(Documents|Downloads|Desktop|AppData)</regex>
  <description>User document directory staged into an archive.</description>
  <group>windows,exfiltration,</group>
</rule>
